## Checklist

- [ ] The tests for the change were written first and failed before the change
- [ ] The CI checks pass locally: `npm run lint`, `npm run knip`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm run size`, `npm run test:coverage` and `npm run smoke`
- [ ] A line under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md, for a user-facing change
- [ ] The change ran end to end in the CLI or the web app, and the observed result is described below
- [ ] Fixtures and examples use synthetic data, with no capture of anyone's real session
